summary: A JSON API on Django and DRF with Django's ORM, migrations and admin, one error envelope and a committed OpenAPI schema.
description: Start a Python JSON API on Django and Django REST Framework with no server-rendered pages. Settings come from environment variables with validated defaults. One notes resource proves the shape: a model and its migration, an admin page, a serializer that refuses unknown fields, and list, create and read endpoints under /v1 with cursor pages. Every failure, from validation errors to unknown paths, answers in one error envelope. Each request is logged with an id, drf-spectacular writes the OpenAPI schema and a check fails when it drifts, and pytest-django drives the API client against a real database. Data lives in SQLite; authentication and Postgres are left to the project.
seoDescription: A Django REST Framework API recipe: ORM, admin, migrations, an OpenAPI drift check, one error envelope and pytest-django tests, managed with uv.

projectExamples.title: Backend for a mobile app with staff admin
projectExamples.description: Illustrative: replace notes with the app's own records, let the phone app read and write them over JSON, and let staff edit them in Django's admin. Sign-in for app users is still to add.

projectExamples.title: Containerised internal records API
projectExamples.description: Illustrative: a few resources other internal services call, shipped as one container image with migrations as a release step. docker-deploy builds and publishes the image; Postgres is a separate step.

plain.whatItIs: A starter Python service built with Django REST Framework that stores records in a database and lets apps or other programs read and save them as data.
